name: graph-explorer-json-query
description: Browser extension (Chrome/Edge) adding JMESPath/JSONPath/jq query capabilities to Microsoft Graph Explorer results.
//: No dependencies: the shipped extension has zero runtime npm packages (see vendor/ + SBOM.md). devDependencies holds the one build/test tool, pinned to an exact version — this is its single source of truth, so GitHub's dependency graph and Dependabot can see it and .github/workflows/build.yml installs exactly this version.

scripts.package: mkdir -p dist && zip -r dist/graph-explorer-json-query.zip manifest.json icons popup src vendor -x '*.DS_Store'
